operation: Create artifact intake slot (upload or pull)
idempotency: Client idempotency key per upload; one slot per key
authorization_timing: Intake: principal or source authorized for the profile purpose and tenant
queue_eligibility: No (must commit synchronously before issuing an upload URL)
failure_behavior: Database unavailable -> refuse honestly, no URL issued
acceptance: Given the database is down, When an upload starts, Then no URL is issued and the user sees 'Not received'

idempotency: Artifact id; storage checksum must equal declared SHA-256
failure_behavior: Checksum mismatch -> slot Abandoned, partial object deleted
acceptance: Given a checksum mismatch, When commit is attempted, Then the artifact is not Quarantined and the object is deleted

operation: Inspect artifact (structure, limits, malware verdict, derivatives)
authorization_timing: None beyond tenant scope (system command on the inspector role)
failure_behavior: Scanner unavailable -> stays Quarantined (fail closed); parser fault -> Rejected with evidence
recovery_behavior: Retry with backoff; poison isolation to the artifact's key only
audit: Verdicts, engine versions, limits observed, derivative ids
user_status: Received - security check pending / Rejected (reason) / Accepted for processing
acceptance: Given the scanner times out, When retries exhaust, Then the artifact remains Quarantined and an exception is open

idempotency: Run id; record keys inside the run
authorization_timing: Validation uses requester authority as of now; re-checked at execution
failure_behavior: Structural failure -> Run Rejected; control-total mismatch -> Rejected
recovery_behavior: Re-run creates a new Run; staged rows immutable
audit: Outcome per record, totals declared vs computed
user_status: Checking N records... / N valid, M need attention
acceptance: Given a control-total mismatch, When validated, Then no record is Valid and the Run is Rejected

operation: Submit run records as business commands
ordering_boundary: Run (submission); each command keeps its own ordering key (e.g. Fund)
failure_behavior: Partial submission crash -> resumes; idempotency prevents duplicates
recovery_behavior: Replay resolves effected records as Duplicate
acceptance: Given a crash after 400 of 1,000 submissions, When resumed, Then exactly 1,000 commands exist

failure_behavior: Continuity break -> Run Rejected; expectation stays Lapsed
recovery_behavior: Superseding file before matching; compensating observations after
acceptance: Given a duplicate prior-day file, When received, Then no new observation is written

failure_behavior: Drift hold -> prior snapshot stays active
audit: Snapshot id, posting date, diff counts
acceptance: Given a revocation snapshot activation, When an affected recurring grant exists, Then its next release is held

operation: Scheduled retrieval of dataset or partner file
failure_behavior: Source unreachable -> retry; expectation may lapse
recovery_behavior: Next schedule; manual fetch by operator
acceptance: Given the IRS site is unreachable, When retries exhaust, Then the expectation lapses after grace and the prior snapshot stays active

authorization_timing: Decision right ingestion.run.release-hold; segregation from uploader where profile requires
acceptance: Given the uploader tries to release their own held run under a segregation profile, When submitted, Then it is refused
Given one approval recorded, When the same person approves again, Then it is refused

authorization_timing: Per request: case/fund permission, step-up above bulk threshold
acceptance: Given access revoked, When a previously issued URL is replayed after expiry, Then it fails

operation: Re-inspect released artifacts after policy or signature change
acceptance: Given a revocation, When a reviewer opens the case, Then the document shows 'unavailable - security review' and the impact list
